`airgap-transfer` is plain markdown: `SKILL.md` and the reference files below. The agent reads them and does the work itself; nothing is installed or run.

## Workflow

Copy this checklist into your reply and tick it off as you go:

```
Air-gap transfer:
- [ ] 1. Inputs match
- [ ] 2. Questions
- [ ] 3. Plan file
- [ ] 4. Approval: send the plan message, then wait
- [ ] 5. Fetch and check what arrived
- [ ] 6. Manual items settled
- [ ] 7. Pack: sizes, split, volumes, documents, checksums
- [ ] 8. Self-check, until every item holds
- [ ] 9. Write the volumes, one medium at a time
- [ ] 10. Hand-off
```

1. **Inputs.** Read the manifest and the blueprint its `Blueprint:` line names. Every component and version in the blueprint's decision table must appear in the manifest and the other way round, and the manifest must name a platform. A row marked "(from airgap-agent)" after its component needs no blueprint row when its component is listed in `docs/airgap/agents.md`: `airgap-agent` adds coding-agent rows without changing the blueprint. The same holds for a row marked "(from airgap-rag)" whose component is listed in `docs/airgap/rag.md`. If not, the manifest is out of date: send the user back to `airgap-architect` and stop.
2. **Questions.** Read [`references/questions.md`](/reference/transfer/questions/); ask only what this transfer needs.
3. **Plan.** Write `docs/airgap/transfer-plan.md` ([`references/bundle.md`](/reference/transfer/bundle/), "The plan file"), one item per row of the manifest. Read [`references/channels.md`](/reference/transfer/channels/) for how the channel splits and orders files.
4. **Approval.** Send the plan message of [`references/fetch.md`](/reference/transfer/fetch/) and end your turn. "Prepare everything" ends here.
5. **Fetch.** After the yes, run the commands of [`references/fetch.md`](/reference/transfer/fetch/) (or the user runs them), record every item's status, and run its checks of what arrived.
6. **Manual items.** For each one, the user adds files under `<bundle>/manual/` or marks it not needed with a reason ([`references/questions.md`](/reference/transfer/questions/)).
7. **Pack.** Follow [`references/bundle.md`](/reference/transfer/bundle/), "Packing, in order", and write the inside documents from [`references/inside.md`](/reference/transfer/inside/).
8. **Self-check.** Check every item below; fix what fails and check again.
9. **Volumes.** [`references/bundle.md`](/reference/transfer/bundle/), "Writing the volumes".
10. **Hand-off.** Below.
